commands.command: cargo clippy -- -D warnings -D clippy::unwrap_used -D clippy::expect_used -D clippy::panic -D clippy::todo -D clippy::unimplemented -D clippy::indexing_slicing -D clippy::as_conversions

rules_satisfied: power10_simple_control_flow: explicit match/early returns, no recursion or panic-driven flow
power10_bounded_loops: single pass over values with no unbounded iteration
power10_checked_results: all fallible operations (checked_add, try_from) propagate errors
zero_forbidden_constructs: no unsafe, unwrap, expect, panic, todo, unimplemented, unreachable
no_lossy_as_conversions: u64::from, u64::try_from, u32::try_from replace all as casts
checked_arithmetic: checked_add for sum, overflow guard against u32::MAX boundary
skipped_gates: cargo +nightly fmt --all -- --check (nightly toolchain not available in environment)
residual_risk: No unsafe code, no panic paths, no unchecked arithmetic, no lossy casts, no post-init allocation. The function uses u64 internal arithmetic with overflow guard at u32::MAX boundary and try_from for all type conversions. All 3 behavior tests pass. Clippy passes with all specified warnings denied.
